Standard: The flight manuals have documented emergency procedures that are clear, with corrective actions that can be accomplished without death, injury, loss of situational awareness, or loss of the air vehicle. Workload is IAW 9.4.1. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine the flight manuals and verify that the information and relevant procedures are documented, complete, and accurate.
(2) Examine the flight manuals and verify that the flight manuals are certified and complete IAW service-applicable procedures (e.g., AFI 11-215, CNAF M‐3710.7).
